proof_requests: Clear close-up of the transmission ID tag/label and any stamped codes on the gearbox case (must be readable).
Video proof of testing: engagement into all gears (P/R/D and others) and confirmation of no abnormal noise.
Photo of fluid condition/level (dipstick/inspection port) and any leak points (pan, seams, ports).
List of included parts (sensors/solenoids/harness connectors/cooler lines) with photos of each connector/port.
response.reason: The photos show a gearbox/transmission assembly, but there is no readable ID/part number and no test evidence. Without those, compatibility and working condition (which drive price) cannot be verified remotely, so the safest next step is to request the decisive proof.
